Cc: Harriet Lane <h.lane@mediq.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot tier selection and bundling — quick help?

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Mediq is excited about using Redwood for a clinical document summarization pilot. Before we spin up the pilot, a couple of quick questions that are blocking our internal approvals: 

- Which tier do you recommend for a 3-month pilot (approx. 150k tokens/day peak)? Is there an explicit upgrade path if we need higher throughput mid-pilot?
- How do feature bundles work (e.g., streaming + structured output + priority support)? Are they additive or available as a single package?
- Any room for a pilot discount or a one-time onboarding credit? Our procurement team asked for rough % ranges so they can estimate spend for the pilot approval form.

I've attached a short requirements doc (Mediq_Pilot_Requirements.pdf) — happy to hop on a short call. Can you also include a simple matrix: pilot cost, upgrade options, and what happens if we downscale after the pilot?

Appreciate the help — Evan

--
Evan Parker
Head of AI Platforms, Mediq Health
ev an.parker@mediq.com | +1 415-555-0122

Attachments: Mediq_Pilot_Requirements.pdf (pdf)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Pilot tier selection and bundling — quick help?

Hi Evan — thanks for the clear note and the requirements doc. Looping in Aditya (pricing) and Monica (onboarding) to confirm operational constraints. Summary and proposed approach below.

Short answers:
- Recommended pilot tier: "Compact+" with a 2x burst bucket. That covers ~150k tokens/day with headroom for short spikes while keeping unit cost predictable.
- Upgrade path: Pingless upgrade to "Core" (higher concurrency, priority preemption) — takes effect within 24 hours and is non-disruptive. Downgrade back to Compact+ is automated at the next billing cycle; short-term bursts beyond the plan incur metered overage at the Compact+ rate unless you pre-commit to the Core tier for the remainder of the billing period.
- Feature bundling: We offer an additive bundle where streaming + structured output + dev-support is a single combinable add-on. We can present both a la carte pricing and a single-bundle price (usually about 12–18% cheaper than buying add-ons separately for pilots).

Attached is a simplified pricing sheet (Redwood_Pack_Pricing_v3.xlsx) that shows pilot estimates, upgrade toggles, and downgrade behavior. Aditya — can you confirm what pilot discount range we can offer (and whether a one-time onboarding credit is ok)? Monica — can you outline how fast we can onboard and what ramp support looks like?

Evan — if that looks reasonable I'll draft a short mutual action plan and a one-page price summary for procurement. When are you available this week for a 30-min alignment call?

Best,

Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 206-555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_Pack_Pricing_v3.xlsx (xlsx)

Lauren / Monica — quick pricing note for the Mediq pilot.

- Pilot discount: we can approve a one-time 15% pilot discount on hosted usage for a 3-month pilot (requires standard pilot MSA + internal credit note).
- Onboarding credit: we can extend a $6k onboarding credit to cover professional services (up to 12 hours of integration support) if Mediq signs the pilot MSA within 7 days.
- Upgrade / downgrade notes: If they upgrade to Core mid-pilot, we do a pro-rated charge for the time on Core, and we can grandfather the upgraded performance for up to 30 days post-pilot if they convert to a 12-month commitment. That grandfathering requires a 12-month commitment at time of conversion.

Deal specifics: ARR impact if they convert at the end of pilot (projected): ~$240k annual run-rate for the Core configuration. Please include DEAL-98721 in the quote so finance can track.

Aditya Rao
Director, Pricing & Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
